passage.label: O believed do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies extending affection while they disbelieved in the truth that came, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves only because you believe in Allah your Lord; if you came out for jihad in My cause seeking My approval take them not as friends; you confide affection but I am most knowing of what you concealed and declared; whoever does it has strayed from soundness of the way; if they gain dominance they would be enemies extending hands and tongues with evil wishing you would disbelieve; never will relatives or children benefit you, the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you, Allah of what you do is Seeing

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّخِذُواْ عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءَ تُلۡقُونَ إِلَيۡهِم بِٱلۡمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدۡ كَفَرُواْ بِمَا جَآءَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ يُخۡرِجُونَ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمۡ أَن تُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ رَبِّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ خَرَجۡتُمۡ جِهَٰدٗا فِي سَبِيلِي وَٱبۡتِغَآءَ مَرۡضَاتِيۚ تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيۡهِم بِٱلۡمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا۠ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَآ أَخۡفَيۡتُمۡ وَمَآ أَعۡلَنتُمۡۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡهُ مِنكُمۡ فَقَدۡ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
إِن يَثۡقَفُوكُمۡ يَكُونُواْ لَكُمۡ أَعۡدَآءٗ وَيَبۡسُطُوٓاْ إِلَيۡكُمۡ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ وَأَلۡسِنَتَهُم بِٱلسُّوٓءِ وَوَدُّواْ لَوۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ
لَن تَنفَعَكُمۡ أَرۡحَامُكُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡۚ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ يَفۡصِلُ بَيۡنَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ

mainSubject.label: Believers forbidden to take Allah's enemies and their own as allies by extending affection to those who rejected the arriving truth and expelled the Prophet and the community solely for believing in Allah; the prohibition tied to their having gone out striving in His cause seeking His approval; secret affection exposed by His knowledge of both the concealed and the declared, with whoever persists named as straying from the sound way; the warning that such people, if dominant, would act as enemies with hands and tongues and wish for their disbelief; kinship and offspring declared useless before the Resurrection judgement under His sight of all deeds

subordinateSubjects.label: Prohibition of allying with Allah's enemies by extending affection to those who expelled the Prophet and believers for their faith, with secret affection exposed by His knowledge of the concealed and declared
Warning that such people, if dominant, would act as enemies with hands and tongues and wish for the believers' disbelief
Kinship and offspring declared useless before the Resurrection judgement under His sight of all deeds

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Secret affection extended to hostile parties despite knowledge of their expulsion of the believers
Wishing that the believers would disbelieve as the hostile party's aim

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Expulsion of the Prophet and the community solely for belief in Allah

relationships.label: Concealed and declared alike known to Allah, with straying from the sound way named as the consequence
Relatives and children unable to benefit before the Resurrection judgement

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the kinship-futility and Resurrection-judgement statement (3) before the Abrahamic pattern opens (4); P2 ends with the possible-affection concession (7) before the two-category justice rule begins (8); P3 covers the permitted and forbidden categories of non-believers (8-9); P4 runs from the examination of emigrant women through compensation rulings, the women's pledge and the closing alliance prohibition (10-13).
